verdict.rationale: Auth0's Token Vault is explicitly documented to obtain, store, and refresh short-lived tokens for third-party APIs (Google, Slack, GitHub, 30+ integrations) so agents act under the user's delegated authority, with CIBA supporting async user consent for sensitive operations. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of Token Vault in production use, and more detail on token scoping/expiry guarantees beyond first-party docs.
